throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f16, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f17, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f18, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f19, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f20, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f21, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f22, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f23, $r4' --asm 'fcmp.seq.s $fcc0, $f8, $f9; fcmp.seq.s $fcc1, $f10, $f11; fcmp.seq.s $fcc2, $f12, $f13; fcmp.seq.s $fcc3, $f14, $f15; fcmp.seq.s $fcc4, $f16, $f17; fcmp.seq.s $fcc5, $f18, $f19; fcmp.seq.s $fcc6, $f20, $f21; fcmp.seq.s $fcc7, $f22, $f23'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
